attributes.title: 2027 FSWA Annual Conference: Creating Pathways to Hope
attributes.series: Forensic Social Work Alliance Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The Forensic Social Work Alliance meets June 7 to 10, 2027, at Caesars Palace in Las Vegas for its annual conference, "Creating Pathways to Hope". The program mixes plenaries, workshops, roundtables, posters and research presentations on social work in courts, corrections, child welfare and other legal settings.

FSWA is an ASWB ACE provider (#1823), and social workers who register for CE can earn up to 17.0 credits. The organization is also a New York State-approved CE provider for licensed social workers under its former name.

Participant fees were not published yet; registration runs through Whova. Abstracts are due November 15, 2026, and the discounted hotel rate is available until May 14, 2027.
